## Command line

### `xcoil-coils`

xcoil-coils: coils for a target plasma boundary, from the command line.

| option | default | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--surface` | `['landreman_paul_qa']` | target surface(s): VMEC input (input.*), wout (*.nc), .npz, a bundled name (w7x, landreman_paul_qa, qh_reactor, cfqs_2b40, rotating_ellipse) or, with simsopt installed, a simsopt JSON file |
| `--ncoils` | `4` | base coils per half period |
| `--order` | `4` | Fourier order of the coils |
| `--length` | `4` | length limit [m] |
| `--per-coil` | off | length limit per coil (default) |
| `--total-length` |  | length limit on all base coils together |
| `--cc` | `0.1` | minimum coil-coil distance [m] |
| `--cs` | `0.15` | minimum coil-surface distance [m] |
| `--curvature` | `3` | maximum curvature [1/m] |
| `--msc` | `4` | maximum mean squared curvature [1/m^2] |
| `--init` | `'3d'` | initial coils (pair: one planar and one 3D start) Choices: circle, planar, 3d, pair, all. |
| `--size` | `'clear'` | size of the initial coils (ignored with --offset / --radius) Choices: clear, L70, L85, L100, half-R0. |
| `--offset` |  | offset distance d [m] (planar, 3d) |
| `--radius` |  | circle radius R1 [m] (circle) |
| `--tilt` | `0` | tilt of the coil planes [deg] |
| `--certify` | `'best'` | best: certify in order of the quick check until one passes; all: every result; none: quick check only Choices: best, all, none. |
| `--target-mean` |  | stop at mean \|B.n\|/\|B\| <= this [%] |
| `--precision` | `'mixed'` | mixed: FP64 geometry, FP32 Biot-Savart kernels, FP64 accumulation (default, fast); fp64: all FP64 Choices: mixed, fp64. |
| `--nq` |  | points per coil (default: a rule resolving the distance limits, nq >= L_coil / (0.06 min(cc, cs)); smaller is faster, e.g. 128 for the default problem) |
| `--total-current` | `300000` | sum of base-coil currents in the outputs [A] |
| `--out` | `'./output_xcoil/'` | output directory (one subfolder per surface) |
| `--no-link-test` |  | allow steps that change coil linking |
| `--screen` |  | with several starts (--init pair / all): run only the first stage of every start, then finish the SCREEN best (e.g. 1) |
| `--max-outer` | `60` | outer iterations per start at most |
| `--max-force` |  | opt-in: maximum coil force per unit length [N/m] (with --total-current as the coils' total current); certified on 768 points per coil |
| `--force-radius` | `0.02` | conductor radius of the force's self-field regularization [m] |
| `--force-margin` | `0.005` | relative margin of the force rows in the solve (covers the gap between the solver's points and the certificate's 768) |
| `--lp-curvature-max` |  | opt-in: limit J_max on each coil's Lp curvature J = (1/p) int max(kappa - threshold, 0)^p dl |
| `--lp-p` | `2` | exponent p of the Lp curvature |
| `--lp-threshold` | `0` | curvature threshold of the Lp curvature [1/m] |
| `--ordering` | off | opt-in: toroidal ordering rows (neighbouring coils may not cross in the (phi, theta) projection about the boundary's geometric axis) |
| `--ordering-gap` | `1` | minimum toroidal gap of the ordering rows [deg] |

### `xcoil-check`

xcoil-check: report the installation (versions, JAX devices and precision, compile cache, bundled boundaries, optional packages) and run one tiny coil solve. Ends with OK when everything works.

| option | default | description |
|---|---|---|
| `--no-solve` | off | only the report, no test solve |

## Python API

### `xcoil.fixed.user_problem`

**`load_boundary(spec)`**

(FourierBoundary, info) from spec: a VMEC / VMEX input file (input.*: RBC / ZBS / NFP), a wout file (*.nc, the
last closed flux surface), an XCoil .npz boundary, a bundled name (landreman_paul_qa, w7x,
qh_reactor, cfqs_2b40, rotating_ellipse) or, with simsopt installed, a simsopt JSON file (surfaces not given as
R, Z series in the cylindrical angle are refitted; info["fit_err_m"] is the fit error). info: source, fit_err_m.

**`read_vmec_input(path)`**

Stellarator-symmetric boundary from a VMEC input namelist (RBC(n,m), ZBS(n,m), NFP).

**`read_wout(path, s_index=-1)`**

Stellarator-symmetric boundary (last flux surface) from a VMEC wout file.

**`write_vmec_input(b, path, name='xcoil')`**

Minimal VMEC-style input file with the boundary (NFP, RBC, ZBS) - readable by read_vmec_input
and by VMEC / simsopt.

**`refit_rz(surface, modes=24, nfit=112)`**

R, Z Fourier series in the cylindrical angle fitted to any simsopt surface (exact cross
sections, one field period, nfit x nfit points). Needs simsopt. Returns (boundary, error [m]).

**`settings(b, ncoils, order, length, per_coil_length, kappa, msc, dcc, dcs, nq=None, grid_dist=None, size_classes=False)`**

Problem settings (the dict make_problem uses). ncoils: base coils per half period; order: Fourier order;
length [m]: per coil (per_coil_length=True) or of all base coils together; kappa [1/m]: maximum curvature;
msc [1/m^2]: maximum mean squared curvature; dcc, dcs [m]: minimum coil-coil and coil-surface distances;
nq: points per coil (default max(128, 16 order, a multiple of 32 >= L_coil / (0.06 min(dcc, dcs))), at most
2048); grid_dist: (nphi, ntheta) of the distance grid (default from the boundary size and dcs).
size_classes: round nq and the distance grid up to the classes of fixed/size_classes.py, so that problems of
the same structure share compiled programs (for runs over many surfaces).

**`make_problem(b, key, arc=None, grid=None, **kw)`**

CoilProblem for boundary b (saved as <XCOIL_USER_DIR>/<key>.npz, default ~/.cache/xcoil/boundaries, and
registered as a device).
arc: overrides of the arclength-penalty settings ARC (arc_pen_thresh [m^2], arc_pen_weight,
arc_pen_intervals), e.g. rescaled for a device of another size; grid: flux grid of the problem
(default: the config's grid_fine). kw: settings() arguments (ncoils, order, length, per_coil_length, kappa, msc,
dcc, dcs, nq, grid_dist, size_classes). Returns (prob, settings dict).

**`initial_coils(prob, init='3d', size='clear', value=None, tilt=0.0)`**

One starting coil set.
  init   "circle": planar circles of radius R1 about the axis point (R00, 0) in each coil plane
                   (as simsopt's create_equally_spaced_curves);
         "planar": planar offsets, by a distance d, of the toroidally averaged cross-section;
         "3d":     surface-following offsets X(theta, phi_c) + d n(theta, phi_c) of the boundary.
  size   "clear" (smallest size with all coils 1.1 d_cs from the surface), "L70" / "L85" / "L100"
         (70 / 85 / 100 % of the length budget), "half-R0" (circles: R1 = R00 / 2, as
         auglag_qa.py); or value: an explicit d [m] (planar, 3d) or R1 [m] (circle).
  tilt   rotation of every coil plane about its e_R axis [deg].
Coil planes at phi_c = (c + 1/2) pi / (nfp C). Returns (Start, check): check = admissibility of
the coils (linked, min coil-coil distance, min coil-surface clearance, total base-coil length).

**`starts(prob, families=('offset_3d', 'offset_planar', 'circle'))`**

Every admissible start of the given families (sizes clear, L70, L85, L100, L85 tilted +-8 deg;
linked or overlapping starts shrunk or dropped).

**`pair(prob)`**

Two starts, one per family: a planar offset and a surface-following (3D) offset - the families
fail on different devices (e.g. planar on the QH reactor).

**`warm_start(start, x, label='warm')`**

A start at the design vector x (e.g. a previous result's r["x"]) with the metadata of `start`: pass it to
solve_all to continue from a design (warm start), e.g. after changing a limit.

**`quick_check(prob, x)`**

Cheap, uncertified metrics of x: mean / max |B.n|/|B| [%] on the certification grid (no fine
grid for the maximum), objective F, largest true-limit violation v (normalized constraint rows),
per-coil lengths, max curvature and MSC at the optimization quadrature, point-sampled minimum
coil-coil and coil-surface distances, and whether any coil pair is linked. One compiled program
for all problems of the same structure (the problem's data are its inputs).

**`solve_all(prob, start_list, precision='mixed', target_mean=None, link_test=True, certify='best', warmup=0, log=<built-in function print>, screen=None, max_outer=60, compile_first=True, repair=True, max_force=None, ordering=None, lp_curvature=None)`**

Solve from every start, then certify (certify "all" | "best" | "none", see the module
docstring). target_mean (percent) stops each solve at the first outer iteration whose
certification-grid mean meets it; otherwise the general rule. max_outer caps the outer
iterations of every start. compile_first=False: no separate compile solve (t_compile 0; the
first solve's time then includes any compilation - for runs over many surfaces, whose
programs are shared and mostly compiled already).
screen=k: screen, then finish - run only the first stage of every start's solve (the first
subproblem, on the coarse grids), rank the starts by screen_key, and finish only the k best;
the others are reported with screened_out=True (their first-stage result, not certified).
repair: a certified-run design that fails only on a distance limit is re-solved with a distance margin sized from
the shortfall (device_lm.repair_distances).
max_force (opt-in): dict(F_lim=..., radius=..., margin=0.0, nq=768), the maximum coil force per unit length F_lim
[N/m] with conductor radius `radius` (constraints/forces.py): rows F / F_lim - (1 - margin) <= 0 on every base coil
in the solve, and the certificate's "force" entry (max per coil on nq points; certified only if within F_lim).
ordering (opt-in): dict(gap_deg=1.0, kappa=20.0, beta=500.0, n_seg=16, axis=None), the toroidal ordering rows
(constraints/ordering.py) about a fixed reference axis (default: the boundary's geometric axis), and the
certificate's "ordering" entry (certified only if no pair crosses and every gap reaches gap_deg).
lp_curvature (opt-in): dict(J_max=..., p=2.0, threshold=0.0, nq=4096), the Lp-curvature rows J_c / J_max - 1
<= 0 per coil (constraints/lp_curvature.py) and the certificate's "lp_curvature" entry (on nq points).
The distance repair re-solves with these rows too.
Returns (results, compile s).

**`best(results)`**

The certified result with the smallest mean, else the best finished one by the quick check.

**`force_limit_in_problem(prob, F_user, total_current)`**

A coil-force limit F_user [N/m] meant for coils whose base coils carry `total_current` [A] together, converted
to the solver's current normalization (base coils at |I0| = 1e6 A each): |dF/dl| scales as I^2, so
F_lim = F_user (C |I0| / total_current)^2. Pass the result as solve_all(max_force=dict(F_lim=...)).

**`force_to_user(prob, F_problem, total_current)`**

Inverse of force_limit_in_problem: forces [N/m] of the solver's normalization at `total_current` [A].

**`physical_coils(prob, x, total_current=None, n=256)`**

(points (Nphys, n, 3) [m], currents (Nphys,) [A] with the symmetry sign, base currents (C,)).

**`write_coils_json(prob, x, path, total_current=None, extra=None)`**

Coils as JSON: base curves as CurveXYZFourier coefficients in simsopt's order (for each of x,
y, z: c0, s1, c1, ..., sM, cM), base currents [A], and the symmetry (nfp copies, each with its
stellarator-flipped mirror of opposite current - simsopt's coils_via_symmetries order).

**`write_makegrid(prob, x, path, total_current=None, n=256)`**

All physical coils in the MAKEGRID coils-file format (points [m], current [A] per point).

**`write_vtk(prob, x, prefix)`**

prefix_surface.vts (full torus StructuredGrid: B.n/|B|, |B|, B.n) and prefix_coils.vtu (all
physical coils as closed polylines: base-coil index and current per coil and per point).

**`write_simsopt(prob, x, path, total_current=None)`**

simsopt BiotSavart JSON of the coils, if simsopt is installed (returns False otherwise).

### `xcoil.homotopy.boundary`

**`FourierBoundary(xm: 'np.ndarray', xn: 'np.ndarray', rc: 'np.ndarray', zs: 'np.ndarray', rs: 'np.ndarray', zc: 'np.ndarray', nfp: 'int', stellsym: 'bool', name: 'str' = '') -> None`**

A plasma boundary as Fourier series in the cylindrical angle phi:
R = sum rc cos(m theta - n nfp phi) + rs sin(...), Z = sum zs sin(m theta - n nfp phi) + zc cos(...), with mode
numbers xm, xn (n in units of nfp; rs = zc = 0 for stellarator symmetry). eval_rz / eval_xyz evaluate it.

**`from_modes(xm, xn, rc, zs, nfp, stellsym=True, rs=None, zc=None, name='')`**

FourierBoundary from mode arrays xm, xn (n in units of nfp), rc, zs [m] (rs, zc: non-symmetric terms).

**`load(name: 'str') -> 'FourierBoundary'`**

A named boundary: a bundled one (landreman_paul_qa, w7x, qh_reactor, cfqs_2b40,
rotating_ellipse) or one registered by user_problem.make_problem ("user/<key>").

**`save(b: 'FourierBoundary', name: 'str')`**

Store b under `name` (see path_of).

**`from_simsopt(surface, name='', tol=0.0) -> 'FourierBoundary'`**

Extract all nonzero modes of a simsopt SurfaceRZFourier (sym and non-sym terms).

**`fit_grid(R, Z, nfp, name='') -> 'FourierBoundary'`**

Tensor-grid input -> Fourier boundary by exact 2D DFT.

R, Z: (ntheta, nphi) on theta_i = 2 pi i/ntheta, phi_j = 2 pi j/(nfp nphi) (one field
period, consistent poloidal label). Returns all resolvable modes (general, non-symmetric).

### `xcoil.constraints.forces`

**`coil_forces(xc, I, cb, sym, delta)`**

(C, nq) |dF/dl| [N/m] on the base coils: base-curve coefficients xc (C * 3K,) on the basis cb, base-coil currents
I (C,) [A], symmetry tables sym, self-field regularization delta.

**`max_force(x, cb, sym, I0, delta)`**

(C,) maximum |dF/dl| per base coil [N/m] on the basis cb (certificate: pass a fine quadrature basis).

**`force_extra(prob, F_lim, radius, margin=0.0, nq=None)`**

Extra constraint rows for fixed.device_lm.build_solver(prob, extra=...): the maximum-force constraint
F / F_lim - (1 - margin) <= 0 on every base coil at nq quadrature points (default: the problem's own), conductor
radius `radius` (same length unit as the problem). No residual rows; the flux rows keep their weight.

**`certify_force(x, prob, F_lim, radius, nq=768)`**

Certificate of the force limit on an nq-point quadrature: dict(max_force (C,) [N/m], F_lim, violation
max(0, max F / F_lim - 1), ok: violation <= 1e-3, the certificate's tolerance).

**`normalized_limit(F_turn, turns, S, I_ref, I_norm)`**

Per-coil |dF/dl| limit [N/m] in the problem's units from a per-turn limit at scale S and total current I_ref.

**`regularization_circ(a)`**

delta of a circular conductor of radius a: a^2 / sqrt(e).

### `xcoil.constraints.lp_curvature`

**`lp_curvature(gd, gdd, p, threshold)`**

Per-coil J_c = (1/p) mean_k max(κ_k - threshold, 0)^p |γ'_k| on a uniform quadrature (gd, gdd: (..., nq, 3)),
the simsopt LpCurveCurvature functional.

**`lp_rows(x, cb, C, J_max, p=2.0, threshold=0.0)`**

(C,) constraint rows J_c / J_max - 1 <= 0.

**`lp_extra(prob, J_max, p=2.0, threshold=0.0, nq=None)`**

Extra constraint rows for fixed.device_lm.build_solver(prob, extra=...): J_c / J_max - 1 <= 0 for every base
coil, on the problem's quadrature (or nq points). J_max in the units of J (1/m^(p-1) for κ in 1/m).

**`certify_lp(x, prob, J_max, p=2.0, threshold=0.0, nq=4096)`**

Certificate of the Lp-curvature limit on an nq-point quadrature: dict(lp_curvature (C,), J_max, violation
max(0, max J / J_max - 1), ok).

### `xcoil.constraints.ordering`

**`axis_from_boundary(b, nmax=8)`**

Geometric axis (a, b) of an XCoil FourierBoundary (its m = 0 modes).

**`axis_from_modes(xm, xn, rc, zs, nfp=None, nmax=8)`**

(a, b), each (nmax + 1,), from boundary modes R = sum rc cos(m theta - n nfp phi), Z = sum zs sin(m theta -
n nfp phi) (n in units of nfp, the XCoil / simsopt convention): a_n = rc(0, n), b_n = -zs(0, n) (n >= 0; a mode
(0, -n) counts as (0, n) with zs's sign flipped). Exactly the poloidal mean of R and Z at each phi.

**`axis_from_points(S, nphi, ntheta, nfp, nmax=8)`**

(a, b) from a full-torus grid of boundary points S (nphi * ntheta, 3), phi-major, phi_j = (j + 1/2) 2 pi /
nphi: the theta-mean of R and Z per phi column, as the Fourier series above (JAX; exact when nphi > 2 nmax nfp).

**`rows(g, a, b, nfp, gap, kappa, beta, n_seg)`**

Normalized ordering rows (<= 0 feasible), (C + 1) * n_seg, from base-coil points g (C, nq, 3); gap [rad].

**`report(g, a, b, nfp, kappa, window=0.03)`**

Hard ordering metrics per pair [deg]: the smallest phi_R - phi_L over point pairs with |theta_L - theta_R| <
window (negative: the coils cross in the projection), the hard theta-penalized gap min [phi_R - phi_L +
kappa (1 - cos dtheta)] that the rows bound from below, and each coil's (min, max) phi.

**`ordering_extra(prob, axis=None, gap_deg=1.0, kappa=20.0, beta=500.0, n_seg=16)`**

Extra constraint rows for fixed.device_lm.build_solver(prob, extra=...): the ordering rows on the problem's
coil quadrature about a FIXED reference axis (default: the geometric axis of prob's boundary). n_seg must divide
the quadrature.

**`certify_ordering(x, prob, axis=None, kappa=20.0, gap_deg=1.0, nq=768, window=0.03)`**

Ordering report on an nq-point quadrature about the fixed axis (default: prob's boundary axis): per pair the
windowed gap and the penalized gap [deg]; ok when no pair crosses (windowed gap > 0) and every penalized gap
reaches gap_deg.

**`pair_names(C)`**

Names of the C + 1 pairs, in row order.

### `xcoil.fixed.device_lm`

**`build_solver(prob, budget, target=None, monitor=None, max_outer=60, viol_tol=0.001, ftol=None, shared=True, extra=None)`**

Returns solve(x0) -> (x, info): the whole AL-LM solve as two jitted device programs
(first outer - on the coarse grids if budget has coarse_grid - and a lax.while_loop over the
remaining outers), no host synchronisation in between.
budget["link_test"] rejects trial steps that change a coil-pair linking number.
Stopping (on device), with v = max(g - margins) the violation of the true limits (the quantity
certification bounds by viol_tol): target=(mean_pct, max_pct) with a monitor -> stop at the
first outer whose monitor values meet the target with v <= viol_tol (time to target);
otherwise (general rule) stop when v <= viol_tol and |F_k - F_{k-1}| <= ftol F_k.
Always stops at max_outer.
shared: the programs take the problem's tables as an input and are cached by structure
(_shared_solver), so devices with the same coils, order, quadrature, grids and settings - any
boundary, any limits - reuse one compiled program; in target mode too when the monitor provides
its test as a function of the problem data (monitor.shared: make_monitor); shared=False compiles programs for
this problem alone (the tables as constants).
extra (Extra): constraint rows appended (_build); programs for this problem alone.

**`build_batched_solver(prob, budget, target=None, monitor=None, max_outer=60, viol_tol=0.001, ftol=None, extra=None)`**

Multi-start: solve_batch(X0) -> (X, info) for B starts X0 (B, n) of the same problem in one
solve - build_solver's two device programs vmapped over the starts (one compiled program per B).
Every member follows its own AL-LM iteration and stopping rule; the batch ends when every member
has stopped (or reached max_outer, the per-member cap), so its time is that of the slowest member,
and finished members are carried along unchanged. info: build_solver's entries as (B,) arrays.

**`Extra(r, g, flux_w=1.0, jr=None, jg=None)`**

Constraint rows added to a solve (build_solver(extra=...)): r(x) extra least-squares residuals (the merit
gets |r|^2 more), g(x) extra constraints g <= 0 (true limit: offset 0), flux_w the weight of the problem's own
flux residual rows (0: those rows are left out, the field enters only through r and g; then irls must be 0).
r and g are JAX functions of the full x; jr / jg their Jacobians (default jax.jacrev). The opt-in limits of
xcoil.constraints (forces.force_extra, ordering.ordering_extra, lp_curvature.lp_extra) are Extras.

**`make_monitor(prob, kdt=<class 'jax.numpy.float32'>)`**

On-device target monitor on the certification's grid and quadrature: (mean, max)
|B.n|/|B| in percent, the same definition as the certificate (a coarser monitor grid
over-estimated the QH max by ~2 %, the size of the target margin). kdt=float32: mixed-precision
field (FP64 separations, FP32 kernel, FP64 accumulation; ~1e-7 relative), kdt=None: FP64.

## Problem settings (HConfig)

`xcoil.homotopy.config.HConfig`, the frozen settings of a coil problem. `make_problem` fills the problem fields from its arguments; the rest keep these defaults.

| field | default | units | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `surface` | `'landreman_paul_qa'` |  | Name of the target boundary (bundled name or user/<key>); set by make_problem. |
| `n_coils` | `4` |  | Base coils per half field period (make_problem ncoils). |
| `stellsym` | `True` |  | Stellarator symmetry of the coil set (always True in make_problem). |
| `kappa_lim` | `5` | 1/m | Maximum pointwise curvature (make_problem kappa). |
| `msc_lim` | `5` | 1/m^2 | Maximum mean squared curvature per coil (make_problem msc). |
| `dcc` | `0.1` | m | Minimum coil-coil distance (make_problem dcc). |
| `dcs` | `0.15` | m | Minimum coil-surface distance (make_problem dcs). |
| `eps_lo` | `13.5` | m | Lower end of the length-cap range of the homotopy tables. |
| `eps_hi` | `19.5` | m | Upper end of the length-cap range (the length limit at t = 1); make_problem sets both to the length limit. |
| `basis` | `'fourier'` |  | Coil representation: 'fourier' (simsopt CurveXYZFourier) or 'bspline'. |
| `order` | `8` |  | Fourier order of every coil (make_problem order). |
| `n_ctrl` | `0` |  | B-spline control points (basis 'bspline' only). |
| `nq_opt` | `128` |  | Quadrature points per coil in the solve (make_problem nq; default rule in settings()). |
| `grid_fine` | `(32, 64)` |  | (nphi, ntheta) flux grid on the boundary for \|B.n\| (per field period). |
| `grid_dist` | `(64, 64)` |  | (nphi, ntheta) full-torus grid of the coil-surface distance soft-min. |
| `path` | `'linear'` |  | Boundary path of the homotopy tables; 'linear' (the fixed-boundary solve uses t = 1). |
| `t_h` | `0.3` |  | Homotopy parameter at which the length cap reaches its target (1 in the fixed-boundary solve). |
| `disp_guard` | `0.4` |  | Largest coil displacement per continuation step as a fraction of min(dcc, dcs). |
| `f_ref` | `0.0001` |  | Reference value of the flux objective: the objective is \|r\|^2 / f_ref (scaling only). |
| `lagrangian_hessian` | `'exact_blockdiag'` |  | Second-order term of the LM model: 'exact_blockdiag' (default), 'gn' or 'blockdiag'. |
| `beta_curv` | `0.03` |  | Relative margin of the curvature and MSC rows in the solve (3 %: the certificate passes). |
| `beta_d` | `0` |  | Relative margin of the distance rows; overridden by the solver budget's dist_margin. |
| `front_param` | `'length'` |  | Which limit the homotopy tables ramp: 'length' (the length cap) or 'kappa' (the curvature limit). |
| `front_L` | `0` | m | Fixed length cap when front_param is 'kappa'. |
| `w_msc_final` | `0` |  | Weight of an MSC penalty in the objective (0: off). |
| `softmin_alpha` | `100` | 1/m | Sharpness of the soft-min of the distance rows (conservative: below the true min). |
| `dist_segments` | `0` |  | Distance rows per coil: 0 = one per quadrature point, n = soft-min over n segments. |
| `verify_grid` | `(64, 128)` |  | (nphi, ntheta) per field period of the certificate's triangulated boundary. |
| `nq_verify` | `768` |  | Quadrature points per coil of the certificate (length, distances). |
| `viol_tol` | `0.001` |  | Certified when every true limit holds to this relative violation (1e-3). |
| `precision` | `'fp64'` |  | Precision of the homotopy tables ('fp64'); the solve's precision is solve_all(precision=). |
| `seed` | `0` |  | Random seed of randomized start variants. |
| `per_coil_length` | `False` |  | True: the length limit applies to every coil; False: to all base coils together. |
| `arc_var_lim` | `0` | m^2 | Per-coil arclength-variation constraint (0: off). |
| `arc_pen_thresh` | `0` | m^2 | Arclength-variation penalty threshold T (make_problem: simsopt auglag default 0.01). |
| `arc_pen_weight` | `1` |  | Weight of the arclength-variation penalty in the objective. |
| `arc_pen_intervals` | `0` |  | Arclength-variation intervals: 0 every point, -1 2*order intervals, n>0 n intervals. |
| `beta_L` | `0.05` |  | Initial length cap of the homotopy: (1 + beta_L) times the seed's length. |
| `w_arc` | `0.001` |  | Weight of the arclength-uniformity regularizer (a gauge term in units of f_ref; 1e-3). |
| `w_L0` | `0.01` |  | Weight of the length regularizer, fading as (1 - t)^2 (0 at the target boundary, t = 1). |
| `w_msc0` | `0` |  | Weight of an MSC regularizer fading as (1 - t)^2 (0 at t = 1). |
| `msc_final_ramp` | `'t2'` |  | How w_msc_final enters: 't2' (ramped in as t^2) or 'none' (constant). |

## Solver budget

The `budget` dict of `device_lm.build_solver`. `solve_all` uses `device_lm.MAIN`, completed by `device_lm.DEFAULTS`; the column shows that value.

| key | solve_all value | description |
|---|---|---|
| `precision` | `'mixed'` | 'mixed' (FP64 geometry, FP32 Biot-Savart kernels, FP64 accumulation; default of solve_all) or 'fp64'. |
| `inner` | `50` | Levenberg-Marquardt steps per outer (augmented-Lagrangian) iteration. |
| `inner_first` | `400` | LM steps of the first outer iteration (the first subproblem, on the coarse grids). |
| `first_prog` | `0.03` | Stop the first subproblem when 10 steps gain less than this fraction of its objective. |
| `first_rel` |  | Stop the first subproblem at \|grad\| <= first_rel \|grad_0\| (off by default). |
| `omega_first` |  | Stationarity tolerance of the first subproblem (None: 1/rho0; 0: run all inner_first steps). |
| `rho0` |  | Initial penalty parameter of the augmented Lagrangian (10). |
| `pen_curv` | `1` | Add the curvature of the arclength-variation penalty to the LM model (1: on). |
| `pen_w_first` | `0.01` | Arclength-penalty weight of the first subproblem only. |
| `coarse_grid` | `'16x32'` | 'nphi x ntheta' flux grid of the first subproblem (e.g. '16x32'; empty: no coarse stage). |
| `coarse_dist` | `'48x32'` | 'nphi x ntheta' distance grid of the first subproblem. |
| `coarse_nq` |  | Points per coil of the first subproblem (default: the problem's). |
| `cc_rows` | `128` | Coil-coil Jacobian rows: only the K most nearly active rows when few are active (0: all). |
| `near_rows` | `0.001` | Near-active row window: rows with c > -near enter the LM model (0: active rows only). |
| `damp` | `'fourier'` | LM damping: 'fourier' (mu diag((1 + m)^2), default) or 'levenberg' (mu I). |
| `rho_rule` | `'guard'` | Penalty update: 'guard' (default), 'conv', 'lancelot' or 'algencan' (see device_lm._al_opts). |
| `rho_fac` |  | Penalty growth factor (10). |
| `rho_max` |  | Penalty cap. |
| `rho_tau` |  | Required decrease factor of the violation measure V for 'conv' / 'algencan' (0.25). |
| `rho_stall` | `3` | Stalled outers before 'guard' raises the penalty (3). |
| `irls` | `0.1` | One IRLS reweighting per outer towards the L1 field ratio sum w\|B.n\| / sum w\|B\| (eps; 0: off). |
| `dist_margin` | `0.01` | Relative margin of the coil-coil and coil-surface rows in the solve (0.01). |
| `cs_window` | `256` | Coil-surface soft-min over the K nearest distance-grid points of each coil point (0: all). |
| `ftol` | `0.01` | Stop when the violation is <= viol_tol and \|F_k - F_{k-1}\| <= ftol F_k. |
| `link_test` |  | Reject trial steps that change a coil-pair linking number (True). |

## Environment variables

Read when xcoil is imported; set them before.

| variable | description |
|---|---|
| `XCOIL_COMPILE_CACHE` | Persistent JAX compilation cache folder, or 'off' (default: JAX_COMPILATION_CACHE_DIR if set, else ~/.cache/xcoil/jax). Set before importing xcoil. |
| `XCOIL_PRECISION` | 'fp64' (default; enables JAX x64), 'fp32' or 'mixed' for the homotopy tables. |
| `XCOIL_TABLES` | 'jax' (default): boundary tables and start checks on the JAX device; 'numpy': on the host (equal at rounding level). |
| `XCOIL_EVAL_CHUNK` | Points x modes per boundary evaluation chunk (default 2^26; bounds memory for big boundaries). |
| `XCOIL_USER_DIR` | Folder of boundaries registered by make_problem (default ~/.cache/xcoil/boundaries). |
| `XCOIL_REF_DIR` | Tests only: folder with the reference solutions some tests compare against (not shipped). |
